epic.intent: Build comprehensive local-first agent control of Windows Bannerlord + War Sails through an MCP server: editor, scenes, terrain/navigation, assets/import/publishing, runtime, diagnostics and recovery. Keep original server/bridge source, dependency locks, config templates and install/repair/uninstall scripts in this repo so a clean checkout can reinstall it. Installed game and kit assets remain local prerequisites. Ground the architecture in REA and primary documentation. One deliberately long sprint and one final human acceptance checkpoint. This chat creates the researched plan only; no implementation run. Native-hook/UI fallback policy is pending owner answer.

successCriteria.text: Version-pinned REA capability atlas covers all editor and runtime subsystem families, with exact identities, evidence, verified invocation routes and explicit unresolved limits.
A locally installable MCP host and engine bridges expose discoverable, typed tools/resources, lifecycle-aware engine-thread execution, jobs, bounded results and recovery.
Agents can author, inspect, edit, save and cold-reopen owned scenes, entities, prefabs, terrain, navigation and scene presentation through end-to-end MCP workflows.
Agents can import/reimport, inspect and edit assets, preserve identities, compile and publish owned modules; packaged content is independently checked and rendered in the shipping client.
Agents can inspect and control explicit local runtime test sessions, evaluate campaign/mission/animation/physics/naval state, collect reproducible diagnostics and verify persistence.

One final single-sprint acceptance proves all mandatory capability families, recovery and existing-mod compatibility using real engine results; installation/runbooks and reproducible evidence are delivered.

epic.title: Bannerlord Modding Engine MCP: full agent control of editor, assets and runtime

bundle.rationale: Exactly one long sprint and one final human checkpoint. REA proof -> contracts -> host/editor/runtime bridges -> bounded jobs/changesets -> editor/asset/runtime families -> integration/reinstall -> independent review -> acceptance. Early publishing core MMR-429 removes a semantic dependency deadlock in asset round-trip checks. Local dedicated harness MMR-430 validates server packaging rather than borrowing singleplayer proof. All 40 work tickets are mandatory and individually covered by acceptance; no internal human checkpoints or silent scope cuts.

entryCriteria.text: Revalidate installed identities and read the planning evidence.
Acquire explicit shared editor/game/install ownership before live probes.

exitCriteria.text: All mandatory capability families demonstrated end-to-end through MCP.
Clean checkout reinstall, repair and final acceptance pass.
No silent scope reduction to mocks, manual-only workflows or deferred families.

sprints.goal: Deliver comprehensive, repo-reinstallable local agent control of the Bannerlord modding engine in one long sprint.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Pin installed game, kit and prior evidence: independently verify Identity manifest includes SHA-256/MVID/version and usable kit/DLC readiness; mismatched-build control fails. Every subsystem has an owner and evidence status; publishing/crash reports retain their original proof limits.

Reverse engineer editor bootstrap, callbacks and command routing: independently verify Startup/tick/save/selection command paths have concrete REA evidence and named gaps. Scratch probes establish thread ownership and the chosen pump in no-scene, scene-switch and teardown states; declarations alone do not pass.

Reverse engineer import, resource database and publishing: independently verify Texture/mesh/material source-to-pack paths and native boundaries are mapped. An owned fixture demonstrates an automated route; headless versus UI-dependent behavior is measured, not assumed.

Reverse engineer runtime and native subsystem lifetimes: independently verify Mode/thread/lifetime matrix covers every runtime family with build-bound evidence. Minimal live read/query/mutation probes establish safe dispatch; unproved dangerous calls remain disabled and required features remain unresolved.

Define complete tools, resources and adapter contracts: independently verify Versioned schemas and adapter contracts cover all operations, errors and lifecycle states. Every required operation maps to implementation and acceptance; unknown feasibility cannot be silently dropped.

Build MCP host and typed protocol surface: independently verify Real MCP client and Inspector exercise discovery/calls/resources plus invalid input and version negotiation. Large outputs use stable bounded pages; log output never corrupts protocol framing.

Build editor module and lifecycle bridge: independently verify Cold start, empty editor, scene load/switch and exit report correct state. Bridge remains responsive without background-thread engine access; missing dependencies have actionable errors.

Build shipping runtime bridge: independently verify Cold connection and transitions retain correct identities and capabilities. Disabled/unloaded bridge preserves baseline gameplay; stale sessions refuse operations.

Implement local IPC, scoped handles and session ownership: independently verify Wrong token/user/build/mode, oversized frame and stale handle are rejected before dispatch. Two clients and two processes cannot cross-mutate or steal ownership.

Implement bounded dispatch, jobs and reconnect receipts: independently verify Stress tests verify predeclared queue/tick-time budgets without starving UI. Disconnect/timeout/cancel tests distinguish completed, failed and outcome-unknown; retries do not duplicate mutations.

Implement changesets, undo, snapshots and path boundaries: independently verify Undo/restore plus cold readback matches baseline; stale revisions and external edits conflict. Path escape and protected-file tests reject writes; partial failure has a recoverable journal.

Implement advanced engine commands and scripting: independently verify Editor and runtime multi-operation scripts produce validated state/readback and structured output. Invalid command, wrong target, excessive output and budget expiry have tested behavior without false rollback claims.

Implement scene discovery, create/open/save and cold reopen: independently verify Create/edit/save-as/close/cold-reopen reproduces persistent scene identity and contents. Unsaved changes, duplicate names and protected scenes produce deterministic conflicts or recovery.

Implement entities, selection, transforms and prefabs: independently verify Nested prefab fixture persists hierarchy, transforms, tags, visibility and identity across reopen. Undo/delete/recreate/stale-handle and occlusion-bearing controls pass using a verified safe route.

Implement script components and property authoring: independently verify Fixture component changes affect visible behavior and survive save/reopen. Invalid types/missing scripts/callback faults produce precise diagnostics without silent loss.

Implement camera, viewport, picking and captures: independently verify Known points project/pick within predeclared tolerances and captures identify the correct scene. A visual edit is checked before/after; unavailable capture is reported explicitly.

Implement terrain height, paint layers and surface authoring: independently verify Nonflat terrain patch/layer persists across reopen and agrees with rendered height/raycast/collision checks. Invalid dimensions, active scene conflicts and unsafe bulk-read lifecycle are handled explicitly. Paint and erase a reproducible foliage fixture; persist/reopen and compare instance counts, placement and visible collision/LOD behavior.

Implement navmesh, paths and traversal diagnostics: independently verify Blocked/passable fixture edits change measured routes after rebuild/save/reopen and shipping use. Disconnected, out-of-bounds and land/sea negative fixtures return correct diagnostics without stale results. Create and edit a curved road and river, save/reopen and verify control points, visible geometry, terrain/water alignment and affected traversal.

Implement lighting, weather, water and scene effects: independently verify Combined environment/water/decal/particle/audio fixture has persisted values and visible/audible evidence. Bakes and teardown honor lifecycle/ownership; unavailable required controls remain blockers.

Implement scene validation and performance reports: independently verify Broken fixtures produce located findings; corrected scene runs and passes. Performance workload, sample interval and observer cost are recorded; timeout/crash never counts as pass.

Implement asset catalog, provenance and dependencies: independently verify Duplicate names resolve to correct effective source; missing references/cycles are diagnosed. Large-pack reads obey memory/result budgets and preserve GUID/format metadata.

Implement texture import, settings and reimport: independently verify Diffuse/normal/specular fixtures import/reimport/publish with checked channels, mips, formats and changed pixels. Repeated requests create no duplicate identities; invalid and interrupted imports recover truthfully.

Implement materials, shaders and compilation: independently verify Packed material records and visible fixture match requested shader/texture/flag changes. Missing references and compile faults produce diagnostics while Native and unrelated instances remain unchanged.

Implement mesh, LOD and collision asset pipeline: independently verify Original LOD/collision fixture imports, renders, collides and survives publish/cold load. Invalid names/scale/missing dependencies are diagnosed; reimport/retry preserves intended identity.

Implement skeleton, animation, skinning and cloth assets: independently verify Owned rigged fixture and animation/cloth setup import, preview, publish and run in shipping test. Bad bones/weights/ranges produce precise diagnostics; motion and persistent binding evidence are retained. A character body/face morph fixture previews, persists, publishes and loads with correct rig/skin binding; invalid ranges or missing resources are diagnosed.

Implement audio, particle and UI resource workflows: independently verify Audio event, particle and UI/sprite fixtures validate, preview and load through the engine. Missing prerequisites/bad references are actionable; a required unsupported workflow stays open rather than being marked done. A localized UI fixture switches between two available test locales and verifies string resolution and glyph rendering after package reload.

Implement module/XML/load-order/build-deploy tooling: independently verify Fixture module and data load in intended modes; bad references/order are rejected. Busy deploy refuses or follows proved lifecycle; baseline launcher/module configuration restores exactly.

Implement publishing and independent package verification: independently verify Published fixtures pass GUID/material/pixel/mesh checks and fresh intended-mode loads. Interrupted publish/retry/stale-cache/unexpected-output tests prevent false completion and unrelated overwrites.

Implement runtime snapshots, object graph and event streams: independently verify Known fixture state and identities match across mode transitions. Destroyed objects, slow consumers and save/load invalidate handles without retained-reference growth.

Implement controlled campaign and mission test commands: independently verify Agent drives campaign and mission experiment, observes effects and restores isolated baseline. Original saves remain unchanged; invalid mode/target/failed reset has explicit recovery.

Implement combat, animation and physics probes: independently verify Fixture motion/collision/hit experiment produces time-stamped state, visible outcome and measured queries. Wrong thread/lifecycle/stale entities are refused; removable instrumentation is compared to baseline.

Implement campaign-map and War Sails tools: independently verify Generated-world land/sea route and naval mission are inspected/controlled with exact identities. Seam-equivalent, invalid port and missing-content cases pass; render/physics and route semantics stay distinct.

Implement save/load, replay inputs and comparisons: independently verify Two fixture worlds survive cold save/load with matching selected graph and untouched original saves. Stale package/build/world and missing-data cases fail clearly before unsafe load or mutation.

Implement crash, hang and performance observability: independently verify Disconnect, process exit and missing-dump controls yield distinct truthful states and recovery. Measurement workload/observer overhead are declared; artifacts and streams obey storage budgets and exclude session secrets.

Deliver repository build/install/repair/uninstall: independently verify Clean checkout plus declared installed prerequisites builds, installs and connects. Reinstall twice, repair missing/corrupt owned files and uninstall restore baseline while preserving user changes. Alternate-path clean checkout builds/installs and registers MCP; remove registration/uninstall, reinstall and reconnect without orphan entries or loss of other registrations. Any required cached/offline input is declared and reproduced.
Deliver agent workflows and runbooks: independently verify Fresh agent follows workflows without hidden manual setup. Examples validate against delivered schemas and accurately label limitations.

Integrate every required workflow against the real engine: independently verify Capability-to-scenario matrix records real results for every mandatory family. Cold reinstall and repeated run pass with independent pack/scene/save checks corroborating engine receipts.

Adversarial review of recovery and existing-mod compatibility: independently verify Every failure family has evidence; no unresolved critical/high defect or silently waived required scope. Representative existing MNBL load/save/render controls and protected-file hashes match baseline; observer effects are distinguished.

Build early publishing job core for asset round-trip tests: independently verify A preexisting owned fixture publishes through MCP with output manifest, real completion and failure/cancel/unknown-state controls. Texture/material/mesh/rig tickets can invoke this core without a dependency on MMR-418; no manual publishing substitution is required.

Add local dedicated-server mode and server-pack validation harness: independently verify A local dedicated-server fixture starts, exposes correct identity and supported MCP operations, loads the owned test module and shuts down cleanly. The harness can load server-packed outputs from MMR-418 and verify dependencies/resource stripping/module behavior; missing prerequisites are blockers, not successful skipped tests.

tickets.body: Independent acceptance owner runs the repo-owned MCP package against pinned editor and shipping client. Re-run every required family through a real MCP client: module/assets -> scene/terrain/navigation/effects -> publish -> shipping mission/campaign/naval -> save/cold-load. Verify visuals, persistent readback and independent package checks. Prove clean-checkout install/repair/reinstall/uninstall with unchanged unrelated configuration/modules/player saves. Exercise recovery, concurrency, stale identity, native faults and build drift. Discovered-only, mocked, disabled or manually substituted required operations do not pass. Infeasibility requires a concrete blocker and explicit owner scope decision. Retain exact source/build/package identities, client transcript, captures and residual defects. This is the only sprint checkpoint; submit report for human approval, never self-approve. This planning chat starts no run.
